{
  "findings": [
    {
      "title": "Screening visit overloaded with procedures",
      "quote": "Tumor tissue sample",
      "page": 53,
      "section": "7.1 Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "burden",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The Screening Visit X includes many procedures (informed consent, medical history, ECG, performance status, tumor tissue sample, randomization, etc.) all on one day, which may be burdensome for patients and sites.",
      "fix": "Consider splitting screening procedures across multiple visits or allowing a screening window."
    },
    {
      "title": "Frequent tumor tissue sample collection",
      "quote": "Tumor tissue sample",
      "page": 53,
      "section": "7.1 Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "burden",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "Tumor tissue sample is listed at screening only, but the protocol requires 20 slides or FFPE block; this may be difficult to obtain and could delay enrollment.",
      "fix": "Clarify if archival tissue is acceptable and provide guidance on handling insufficient samples."
    },
    {
      "title": "Vital signs not collected at Day 8 and Day 15",
      "quote": "Vital signs",
      "page": 53,
      "section": "7.1 Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "Vital signs are collected at Day 1, Day 22, and Day 29, but not at Day 8 and Day 15, even though other procedures (e.g., irinotecan, gemcitabine) occur on those days. This may be an oversight.",
      "fix": "Add vital signs to Day 8 and Day 15 visits for safety monitoring."
    },
    {
      "title": "Limited physical examination not at Day 8 and Day 15",
      "quote": "Limited physical examination",
      "page": 53,
      "section": "7.1 Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "Limited physical examination is only at Day 1 and Day 22, but patients receive treatment on Day 8 and Day 15; a physical exam may be needed for safety.",
      "fix": "Add limited physical examination to Day 8 and Day 15 visits."
    },
    {
      "title": "CT/MRI only at screening and Day 42",
      "quote": "CT scan and/or MRI",
      "page": 53,
      "section": "7.1 Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "Tumor assessments are only at screening and Day 42, but Section 7.2.2 states assessments are at end of cycles 1-4, 6, 8, etc. This schedule may not align with cycle lengths.",
      "fix": "Align the Schedule of Activities with the response assessment timing described in Section 7.2.2."
    },
    {
      "title": "Height and weight only at screening and Day 1",
      "quote": "Weight and height (height at screening only)",
      "page": 53,
      "section": "7.1 Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "burden",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "Weight is only measured at screening and Day 1, but weight changes may be important for dosing and safety monitoring throughout the study.",
      "fix": "Consider measuring weight at each treatment visit."
    },
    {
      "title": "Cemiplimab and pemetrexed only on Day 1 and Day 22",
      "quote": "Cemiplimab (experimental)",
      "page": 53,
      "section": "7.1 Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "Cemiplimab and pemetrexed are only given on Day 1 and Day 22, but other drugs (irinotecan, gemcitabine, vinorelbine) are given more frequently. This may be correct but needs clear rationale.",
      "fix": "Verify dosing schedule matches protocol text and provide rationale for the frequency."
    },
    {
      "title": "ECG only at screening",
      "quote": "Electrocardiogram",
      "page": 53,
      "section": "7.1 Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "ECG is only performed at screening, but some drugs (e.g., irinotecan) may have cardiac effects; consider monitoring ECGs during treatment.",
      "fix": "Add ECGs at key timepoints during treatment if needed for safety."
    }
  ]
}
